{{Top|leg}}
'''Ion fields''' were capable of distorting and disrupting the effects of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. [[Blast vest/Legends|Blast vests]], such as the [[Corondexx Blast Vest]], was capable of generating an ion field to provide some modest protection during combat.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
